name: Zentsūji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Zentsūji city emblem in blue: a stylised winged device with a pointed base and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Zentsūji, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 October 1954.

features.role: Zentsūji city emblem — a stylised winged device with a pointed base and a disc
